coverage.golden: RFC 8439 §2.1 quarter round (verification/tests/chacha20_golden.py); no GNU Radio counterpart
coverage.anchors: RFC 8439 §2.1.1 quarter-round vector AND §2.2.1 QUARTERROUND(2,7,8,13) state vector — both exact ON CHIP
coverage.edge: 7 wrapping corners incl. 0xFFFFFFFF x4, a+b == 2**32, the sign-bit corner and the Q15 rail — WRAPS, never saturates
coverage.rate: 8 words in / 8 words out; partial frame never emitted
coverage.placements: RFC vector exact from all 8 anchors the 8x3 fold fits (corridor disjointness is anchor-dependent for big folds)
coverage.mutation: each rotate constant 16/12/8/7 perturbed +-1 independently (8 cases) / each of the 4 adds swapped for xor / DROPPED CARRY (16-bit adds, no ADC) / rot16 hi-lo swap reversed / frame word order reversed / hi-lo swapped / +1 frame shift / identity passthrough / empty
coverage.mutation_onchip: 3 REAL mutants built+placed+routed+run on simKYT, each caught while still emitting the right word COUNT: rot7 built as rot6; ADC->ADD (dropped carry); the free rot16 hi/lo swap removed
coverage.structural: INV-33 no cell overlaps its own instructions (with an INV-4 negative on the pre-fix 8-word egress cell); positional pairing; every entry reachable; folded layout, I/O co-located, ONE output port
coverage.instr_measured: 32-bit ADD=4 (ADD/MOVE/ADC/MOVE), XOR=4, ROTL32(x,16)=0 (hi/lo swap folded into the relay), ROTL32(x,n<16)=7 over 2 cells (4 ROL + 3 merge)
coverage.note: exact 32-bit modular integer arithmetic, NOT Q15; raw 16-bit words, tolerance 0, delay 0
